name: My Elf Girlfriend
source:
Managing your parent’s coffee shop can be difficult, especially if you’re a student. But a chance encounter with a mysterious girl changes your life when you find out that she’s an elf. Not just any elf—she is, in fact, the princess of a royal kingdom!

Things get more interesting when her beautiful handmaiden arrives. It’s now up to you to protect them from a sword-wielding knight, a pair of elf assassins, and the dreaded King of Elves himself. Fortunately, you won’t be alone in this journey, because one of your best customers, who also harbors a deep secret, will be there to assist you.

Can you bridge the delicate gap between elves and humans? More importantly, will you be able to seduce the girls and capture their hearts in the end? You get to choose!
translation:
经营父母的咖啡店并不容易，尤其当你还是学生的时候。然而，一次与神秘女孩的偶遇改变了你的生活：你发现，她竟是精灵。而且不只是普通精灵——她其实是一位公主！

当她美丽的侍女也来到这里，事情变得更加有趣。如今，你必须保护她们，应对持剑骑士、两名精灵刺客，以及可怕的精灵王本人。幸好，这段旅程并非只有你一人：店里一位最忠实的顾客也会出手相助，而这位顾客同样隐藏着重大秘密。

你能弥合精灵与人类之间微妙的隔阂吗？更重要的是，你最终能否打动这些女孩，俘获她们的心？一切由你选择！
